title: Vallée's assessment of the Billy Meier photos
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Vallée's assessment of the Billy Meier photos, about late 1970s at Switzerland, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: but Jacqu Valet has looked at some of these photos.

plain: A philosopher and researcher named Jason Jorjani, talking on Jesse Michels's podcast, mentions photographs taken in Switzerland in the late 1970s by Billy Meier, a Swiss man who says he met beings from space. Jorjani says that Jacques Vallée, a long-time UFO researcher, has looked at some of these photos, and he brings this up as if an expert's look gives the pictures some weight.
